item.title: Sam Darnold's injury is short term, still no firm timeline, Seahawks say
item.description: Darnold is unlikely to land on injured reserve with what a team spokesperson called a "very unique, soft-tissue injury."

item.description: P.J. Locke will step in for Hooker and expect rookie Jaishawn Barham to get more reps in Overshown's spot.

item.title: Ravens mulling wide receiver addition after Zay Flowers, Ja'Kobi Lane injuries

item.title: Browns plan to stick with Deshaun Watson as starter for Week 2 game vs. Bucs
item.description: Watson led Cleveland's offense to just 10 points in a season-opening loss to Jacksonville.
item.media:description: Following a blowout loss to Jacksonville on Sunday, Deshaun Watson is 9-11 as Cleveland’s starter since arriving in a 2022 trade with Houston.

item.title: Vikings QB Kyler Murray remains in concussion protocol; status for Week 2 is uncertain
item.description: Murray's status for the Vikings' Week 2 matchup with the Bears is uncertain. If he is not cleared, Carson Wentz would likely get the start.
item.media:description: Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray left Sunday's game against the Packers after suffering a head injury in the first quarter.
